## Load libraries
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse) # for dplyr, tidyr, and ggplot2
library(patchwork) # for figures 
library(flextable) # for making tables 

```
## Making custom palettes for graphing 
```{r palettes}

palette2 <- c("#009e73", "#DDCC77", "#cc79a7", "#0072b2", "#d55e00") 

shapes <- c(15,16,17,18,8)
  
lines <- c(2,1,3,5,4) # not used 
```
## Loading Raw Data
Super_HeadNum is the count of superficial neuromasts on the head, Super_TrunkNum is the count of superficial neuromasts on the trunk, Canal_HeadNum is the count of canal neuromasts on the head, Canal_TrunkNum is the count of canal neuromasts on the trunk, and total is the total amount of neuromasts regardless of type and location.  
```{r}
fish.raw <- read.csv("NeuromastCounts6.csv")
fish.raw
```
## Cleaning Raw Data & Ordering Function
```{r}
# SH = superficial head, ST = superficial trunk, CH = canal head, CT = canal trunk

fish.clean <- fish.raw %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Super_HeadNum)) %>% 
  filter_out(Treatment == "0.002% 48h") %>% # did not use this treatment in end analysis
  rename(SH.raw = Super_HeadNum,
         ST.raw = Super_TrunkNum,
         CH.raw = Canal_HeadNum,
         CT.raw = Canal_TrunkNum,
         Total.raw = Total
         )

# This will order the treatments properly in order of increasing dose 
# This will also order the species in the order of their relationships
fn.order = function(x) {

x$Treatment <- factor(x$Treatment, levels = c("Control", "0.001%", "0.002%", "0.003%"))
x$Species <- factor(x$Species, levels = c("Giant_Danio", "Zebrafish", "Cherry_Barb", "Neon_Tetra", "Black_Tetra"))
levels(x$Treatment)

return(x)

}


```

# Summary statistics for tables 
```{r sum stats}

# Neuromast count averages 
all.avg <- fish.clean %>%
  select(-c(Body_Length,Individual)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !c(Treatment, Species), 
               names_to = "NeuromastType", 
               values_to = "count") %>%
  group_by(Species,Treatment,NeuromastType) %>% 
  summarize(mean = mean(count),
            sd = sd(count))
  

# Combine Mean and SD, then pivot wide for cleaner layout
table_data <- all.avg %>% 
  # Format numeric values to integer
  mutate(mean_sd = sprintf("%.0f ± %.0f", mean, sd)) %>% # no values after decimal place
  select(Species, Treatment, NeuromastType, mean_sd) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = NeuromastType, values_from = mean_sd)

# Make treatmnet ordered
table_data <- table_data %>% 
  mutate(Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Control", "0.001%", "0.002%", "0.003%")))

# Explicitly arrange and align column order to match headers
table_data <- table_data %>%
  arrange(Species, Treatment) %>%
  select(Species, Treatment, CH.raw, CT.raw, SH.raw, ST.raw, Total.raw)

# Format table
publication_table_flex <- table_data %>% 
  flextable() %>% 
  # Apply a clean, minimalist scientific layout
  theme_booktabs() %>% 
  # Merge identical adjacent Species rows vertically
  merge_v(j = ~ Species) %>% 
  set_header_labels(
    Species = "Species", 
    Treatment = "Treatment", 
    CH.raw = "Head", 
    CT.raw = "Trunk", 
    SH.raw = "Head", 
    ST.raw = "Trunk", 
    Total.raw = "Total" 
  ) %>% 
  add_header_row(
    top = TRUE,                  # Places this row above the sub-labels
    values = c("", "", "Canal", "Superficial", "Total"), # Fixed the trailing comma here
    colwidths = c(1, 1, 2, 2, 1) # Matches the exact number of columns
  ) %>% 
  # Center align headers and counts for standard publication style
  align(i = 1:2, align = "center", part = "header") %>% 
  align(j = 3:7, align = "center", part = "body") %>% 
  set_caption("Table S1. Average neuromast counts across species and doses of gentamicin. Neuromast averages are categorized by canal neuromasts on the head and the trunk, superficial neuromasts on the head and the trunk, and the total number of all types of neuromasts. Averages and standard deviations (SD) are reported as integers.") %>% 
  autofit()

# Save the table to a Word document 
save_as_docx(
  "Table S1" = publication_table_flex, 
  path = "TableS1.docx"
)


```

### Percent of total neuromasts calculations and plots ###

# Calculations for the 4 percent of total plots (ignore)
Location and neuromast type by treatment. 

```{r}
fish.num <- fish.clean %>% select(-c(Individual, Body_Length, Total.raw))

# Get the control count to divide by 
fish.avgs <- fish.num %>% filter(Treatment == "Control") %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarize(SH.means = mean(SH.raw),
            ST.means = mean(ST.raw),
            CH.means = mean(CH.raw),
            CT.means = mean(CT.raw))

fish.map <- fish.num %>% 
  left_join(fish.avgs, by = "Species")

# ~ is shorthand for making a new function, .x is a placeholder for the thing being currently processed
fish.cent <- fish.map %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = ends_with(".raw"),
    .fns = ~ round(.x / get(str_replace(cur_column(), ".raw", ".means")) * 100, 2),
    .names = "percent.{.col}"
    ),
    .keep = "unused") %>%
  rename(`SH` = percent.SH.raw,
         `ST` = percent.ST.raw,
         `CH` = percent.CH.raw,
         `CT` = percent.CT.raw)


fish.cent <- fn.order(fish.cent)

fish.avgs

```
# All four plots combined by location and neuromast type (ignore)
Count data
```{r}


for (var.col in c("SH", "ST", "CH", "CT" )) {
  
    var.cent <- fish.cent %>% select(c(Species, Treatment, sym(var.col)))
    var.sum <- var.cent %>% group_by(Species, Treatment) %>%
      summarize(
        mean = mean(!!sym(var.col)),
        sd = sd(!!sym(var.col)), .groups = "drop_last"
      )
  
    
    var.plot <- ggplot(var.sum, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean, color = Species)) +
      geom_point(size = 1.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      geom_point(data = var.cent, 
                 aes(y = !!sym(var.col)), 
                 size = 0.5, 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), 
                 alpha = 0.3) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), 
                    width = 0.2, 
                    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      scale_color_manual(values = palette2) +
      labs(x = "Dose", y = paste0("% of Mean ", var.col, " Control Neuomasts")) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
            plot.tag = element_text(size = 10))
    
   assign(str_glue('{var.col}.plot'), var.plot) 
   
  }

fullplot <- ((SH.plot | ST.plot) / (CH.plot | CT.plot))
fullplot <- fullplot + 
            plot_layout(guides = 'collect') +
            plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

fullplot

```

# Neuromast type by location -Calculations 
Used in publcation. 
```{r calc}

# Reduce neuromast count columns to one column with levels of neuromast type (location and type)
type <- fish.clean %>% select(-c(Individual, Body_Length)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !c(Treatment, Species), 
               names_to = "NeuromastType", 
               values_to = "count")

# get the averages of counts for control fish of each species 
type.avg <- type %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "Control") %>%
  group_by(Species, NeuromastType) %>%
  summarise(mean.ctrl = mean(count[NeuromastType=="Total.raw"]))


# Add the calculated control averages to the count data for each individual across treatments 
type.map <- type %>% 
  left_join(type.avg, by = c("Species", "NeuromastType"))%>%
  fill(mean.ctrl, .direction = "down") %>% # fill in surrounding cells for the same species
  fill(mean.ctrl, .direction = "up") %>%
  ungroup()

# Calculate the percent of the total control neuromasts for each treatment and each species (individual data)
type.cent <- type.map %>%
  group_by(Treatment,Species,NeuromastType) %>%
  mutate(Percent = count / mean.ctrl * 100,
         .keep = "unused") 

type.cent <- fn.order(type.cent)
type.cent

# Remove total percent 
type.cent <- type.cent %>%
  filter(NeuromastType != "Total.raw")

type.cent # use this to plot individual points per fish per treatment

# Now get summary of the variance for the big dots on the plot 
type.cent.mean <- type.cent %>% 
  group_by(Species,Treatment,NeuromastType) %>%
  summarize(mean.percent = mean(Percent),
            sd.percent = sd(Percent))
  

```

# Total overall neuromasts - Calculations
```{r}
# CALCULATIONS
total.num <- fish.clean %>% select(c('Species', 'Treatment', 'Total.raw'))

total.num <- fn.order(total.num)

total.avgs <- total.num %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "Control") %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarize(total.means = mean(Total.raw))

total.map <- total.num %>%
  left_join(total.avgs, by = "Species")

total.cent <- total.map %>%
  mutate('%_of_Control' = Total.raw/total.means*100,
         .keep = "unused")
total.cent
```
# Total overall neuromasts - Plot 
```{r}
total.sum <- total.cent %>% group_by(Species, Treatment) %>%
      summarize(
        mean = mean(`%_of_Control`),
        sd = sd(`%_of_Control`), 
        .groups = "drop_last")
    
total.plot <- ggplot(total.sum, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean, color = Species,shape=Species)) +
      geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      geom_line(aes(group = Species), # adds line across points
                position = position_dodge(width=0.5),
                alpha=0.7)+
      geom_point(data = total.cent, 
                 aes(y = `%_of_Control`), 
                 size = 2, 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), 
                 alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), 
                    width = 0.1, 
                    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 5,linetype = "dashed")+
      scale_color_manual(values = palette2) +
  scale_shape_manual(values =shapes)+

            panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray", linewidth = 0.3), # horizontal
            legend.position = "top")
```

## Dividing Neuromasts by Type
# Calculations for neuromasts grouped by type (superficial vs canal)
```{r}
SupCanTot <- fish.clean %>% select(-c(Individual, Body_Length)) %>%
  mutate(Canal = CH.raw + CT.raw,
         Superficial = SH.raw + ST.raw,
         .keep = "unused") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !c(Treatment, Species), 
               names_to = "NeuromastType", 
               values_to = "count")

SCT.avgs <- SupCanTot %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "Control") %>%
  group_by(Species, NeuromastType) %>%
  summarise(mean.ctrl = mean(count[NeuromastType=="Total.raw"]))

SCT.map <- SupCanTot %>% 
  left_join(SCT.avgs, by = c("Species","NeuromastType")) %>%
   fill(mean.ctrl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(mean.ctrl, .direction = "up") %>%
  ungroup()


SCT.cent <- SCT.map %>%
  group_by(Treatment,Species,NeuromastType) %>%
  mutate(Percent = count / mean.ctrl * 100,
         .keep = "unused")

SCT.cent <- fn.order(SCT.cent)

# Remove total percent 
SCT.cent <- SCT.cent %>%
  filter(NeuromastType != "Total.raw")

# to get the summary 
SCT.cent.mean <- SCT.cent %>%
  group_by(Species,Treatment,NeuromastType) %>%
  summarize(mean.percent = mean(Percent),
            sd.percent= (sd(Percent)))


```

# Dividing all types by total mean AND plotting (unused)
```{r}
alt.SCT.map <- SupCanTot %>% 
  left_join(total.avgs, by = c("Species"))

alt.SCT.cent <- alt.SCT.map %>%
  mutate(Percent = count / total.means * 100,
         .keep = "unused")

alt.SCT.cent$Treatment <- factor(alt.SCT.cent$Treatment, levels = c("Control", "0.001%", "0.002%", "0.003%"))
alt.SCT.cent$Species <- factor(alt.SCT.cent$Species, levels = c("Giant_Danio", "Zebrafish", "Cherry_Barb", "Neon_Tetra", "Black_Tetra"))

for (var in c("Total", "Superficial", "Canal")) {
  
    if (var == "Total") {
      psize = 1
    } else {
      psize = 0.6
    }
  
    var.cent <- alt.SCT.cent %>% filter(NeuromastType == sym(var))
    var.sum <- var.cent %>% group_by(Species, Treatment) %>%
      summarize(
        mean = mean(Percent),
        sd = sd(Percent), 
        .groups = "drop_last")
    
    var.plot <- ggplot(var.sum, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean, color = Species)) +
      geom_line(aes(group = Species),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
                alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_point(size = 2.5 * psize, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), 
                    width = 0.15, 
                    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      geom_point(data = var.cent, 
                 aes(y = Percent), 
                 size = 1.3 * psize, 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), 
                 alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 5,linetype = "dashed") +
      scale_color_manual(values = palette2) +
      labs(x = "Dose", y = paste0(var, " Neuromasts (%)")) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
            legend.position = "none",
            aspect.ratio = 1/1.25,
            panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "lightgray", linewidth = 0.3), # vertical lines
            panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "lightgray", linewidth = 0.3) # horizontal
            )
   
    assign(str_glue('alt.{var}.plot'), var.plot)
    
    }

alt.SCT.plot <- total.plot | (alt.Superficial.plot / alt.Canal.plot)
alt.SCT.plot <- alt.SCT.plot + plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1))
alt.SCT.plot

```
#Dividing by Head vs Trunk Calcs AND plotting (unused)
```{r HEAD VS TRUNK}
HeadTrunk <- fish.clean %>% select(-c(Individual, Body_Length, Total.raw)) %>%
  mutate(trunk = CT.raw + ST.raw,
         head = SH.raw + CH.raw,
         .keep = "unused") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !c(Treatment, Species), 
               names_to = "NeuromastLoc", 
               values_to = "count")


HT.avgs <- HeadTrunk %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "Control") %>%
  group_by(Species, NeuromastLoc) %>%
  summarise(mean.ctrl = mean(count))

HT.map <- HeadTrunk %>% 
  left_join(HT.avgs, by = c("Species", "NeuromastLoc"))


HT.cent <- HT.map %>%
  mutate(Percent = count / mean.ctrl * 100,
         .keep = "unused")

HT.cent <- fn.order(HT.cent)


for (var in c("trunk", "head")) {
  
  psize = 1
  
    var.cent <- HT.cent %>% filter(NeuromastLoc == sym(var))
    var.sum <- var.cent %>% group_by(Species, Treatment) %>%
      summarize(
        mean = mean(Percent),
        sd = sd(Percent), 
        .groups = "drop_last")
    
    var.plot <- ggplot(var.sum, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean, color = Species)) +
      geom_line(aes(group = Species),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
                alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_point(size = 2.5 * psize, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), 
                    width = 0.15, 
                    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      geom_point(data = var.cent, 
                 aes(y = Percent), 
                 size = 1.3 * psize, 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), 
                 alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 5,linetype = "dashed") +
      scale_color_manual(values = palette2) +
      labs(x = "Dose", y = paste0(var, " Neuromasts (%)")) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
            legend.position = "none",
            aspect.ratio = 1/1.25,
            panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "lightgray", linewidth = 0.3), # vertical lines
            panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "lightgray", linewidth = 0.3) # horizontal
            )
   
    assign(str_glue('{var}.plot'), var.plot)
    
    }

HT.plot <- head.plot | trunk.plot
HT.plot


```

```{r}
bodylengths <- fish.raw %>% select(c(Species, Body_Length)) %>%
  mutate('unitless' = Body_Length %>% str_replace_all(c(" " = "", "m" = "")) %>% as.numeric(),
                    .keep = "unused")

bodylengths
  
body.sum <- bodylengths %>% filter_out(is.na(unitless)) %>% group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(mean = round(mean(unitless, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
            sd = round(sd(unitless, na.rm = TRUE) ,1),
            count = length(unitless))
```
